dataList.content:
Unh... Ahheahii...
唔……啊啊唔啊噫……

Dante, do you feel the Golden Bough's presence nearby?
但丁，你能感觉到周围存在金枝吗？

Last time I saw, the Golden Bough was lodged into Dongbaek's body...
我最后一次看到金枝是在它刺入了冬柏的身体里的时候……

<I can't find her corpse anywhere... Must have been moved away when the space twisted.>
<应该是空间变换的原因……在哪我都找不到她的尸体。>

<But it can't be too far away, I'm sure of it. I can feel it...>
<但我确信不会离得太远。我能感觉到……>

Ah, I don't see Dongrang, either.
啊，我也没看到东朗先生。

He's likely to be in the same location as the deceased Dongbaek.
他很可能和冬柏的遗体在同一个地方。

Until now... we've experienced the fathoms of ego at the same time. I guess it's thanks to Dante's particular... affinity, if that makes sense...?
目前为止……我们都同时经历了自我心道。我想这要归功于我们和但丁经理的亲密联系……是这样吗……？

The hell are you talking about. Affinity?
你到底在胡说什么啊。亲密联系？

Do you mean the chains binding us?
你指的是将我们绑定在一起的纽带吗？

Yeah... This is one of their influences, right?
对……这也是纽带造成的影响之一吧？

Then, what will happen if someone like Dongrang gets to the fathoms?
那么，如果像东朗先生这样的人探寻到自我心道，会发生什么呢？

Fret not, for we shall find out from now on!
不必担心，吾等从现在起开始寻找就行！

Let us vanquish the foes ahead for now!
总之先打倒面前的敌人吧！
